name: Candyman
description: Candyman (also known as Drug Dealer) is a social deduction game using playing cards to assign secret roles. The Candyman tries to secretly wink at Buyers to sell 'candy' while the Cop tries to identify and bust the Candyman before all deals are made.

content.text: Candyman (also known as Drug Dealer) is a social deduction game using playing cards to assign secret roles. The Candyman tries to secretly wink at Buyers to sell 'candy' while the Cop tries to identify and bust the Candyman before all deals are made.

Candyman (also known as Drug Dealer) is a modern social deduction party game that uses playing cards to assign secret roles. The game was documented by Bonnie Fishell and has become popular as a party game due to its simple rules and social interaction elements.
4+ players (best with 6-10). No partnerships - each player has individual objectives based on their secret role.
Standard 52-card pack using only: 1 Ace (Candyman), 1 King (Cop), and numeral cards (2-10) equal to remaining player count. Total cards = number of players.
Standard deck of cards, score sheet for tracking points across rounds

Shuffle the selected cards (1 Ace, 1 King, numeral cards for remaining players). Each player draws one card and looks at it secretly. Do not reveal cards to other players. Ace = Candyman, King = Cop, Numeral = Buyer.
